title: sarcopoterium spinosum
intro: Sarcopoterium spinosum, commonly known as Thorny Burnet or Mediterranean Burnet, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Sarcopoterium spinosum include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
